notes: Where qa-tester/testing-apps save run evidence: a video per happy-path scenario, and a screenshot plus a video per bug. Each run lands in <dir>/<ticket-or-session>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<web|ios|android>/{happy-path,bugs}/. mode: "auto" (default) records and saves every run without asking; "ask" makes the delegating conversation ask the user before each run whether to record and save.
